notes.title: Metal Dead Steam Edition
notes.content:
UPDATE: The release has been delayed 'til October 6th - apologies for the wait! We ran into some problems with the Linux version, which we're working on fixing and will hopefully include it in an update very soon.

Walk Thru Walls Studios is proud to present [b]Metal Dead's[/b] premiere on Steam!

[b]Metal Dead[/b] now includes:
- Full Steam integration
- 13 Steam Achievements
- Metal Dead trading cards
- Linux support (to be added in an upcoming update)

We're looking forward to drenching you all in blood and gore on October 6th.

tags.feature: - Linux support (to be added in an upcoming update)
